info.title: CodeGo v3 control API
info.description: Control-plane API. Monetary integers represent micro credits; one credit equals 1000000 micro credits. Wallet includes an exact decimal string for JavaScript clients.

get.description: Read-only historical audit. Ordinary sessions can read only their own records; administrator sessions may filter other users. API keys are always scoped to their current owner and key, including keys owned by an administrator. Attempt ownership is checked against the parent request; unknown and foreign requests return the same 404.

schema.description: Optional single valid calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, years0001..9999. Explicit empty or duplicate values return400; omitted uses current Asia/Shanghai day.

get.description: Root session only, based on the authenticated identity root role. Ordinary users and administrators return403; unauthenticated requests and gateway API keys return401. Returns actual DailyFundingEconomics for one Asia/Shanghai calendar day without changing balances, source allocations or frozen multipliers. An omitted day uses the current Shanghai day; explicit empty or duplicate day values are rejected400, as are non-calendar/zero-year dates.

Retained financial evidence belonging to the session user, including owned wallet, subscription and API-key accounts. Signed amounts and nullable historical balances preserve original evidence and never change the current balance or outbox. Follow next_before until absent.

CatalogPrefillUpdateInput.description: model/tag items must be a non-null array of nonblank strings. endpoint items must be a JSON object or array.

FundingDailyEconomics.description: Root-only daily procurement report from settled request economics and actual frozen funding-source allocations. Monetary values are exact int64 micro credits; profits are signed and costs/revenues nonnegative. Unattributed sources remain separately disclosed rather than recognized revenue. All reporting boundaries are Asia/Shanghai midnight.

IssueRedemptionInput.description: Omitted redeem_type defaults to credits. Exactly one benefit: positive credits with no plan/boxes; subscription with a positive plan_id and zero credits/boxes; blind_box with quantity1..100 and zero credits/plan. expires_at may be omitted/null or must be in the future. name is optional. Retired quota/points types are not native benefits.

JSONValue.description: Arbitrary JSON for provider configuration, user settings, captured request/response or WebAuthn payloads. Go retains raw JSON bytes so nested decimal/integer values are never rounded.

upgrade_group.description: Optional existing pricing group granted by this paid plan. Trimmed before validation; empty means no group change.

model_limits.description: Optional per-model monetary caps in exact int64 micro credits. Keys are trimmed nonblank model names with at most200bytes; negative values are rejected and zero entries are removed, leaving positive caps only.

upgrade_group.description: Optional existing pricing group granted by this paid plan. Trimmed before validation; empty means no group change.

model_limits.description: Optional per-model monetary caps in exact int64 micro credits. Keys are trimmed nonblank model names with at most200bytes; negative values are rejected and zero entries are removed, leaving positive caps only.

RedemptionResult.description: Durable typed redemption benefit receipt. Optional subscription/order receipt IDs may be absent on retained already-used historical codes; these benefits are never granted again. credits is an exact int64 micro-credit amount, zero for nonmonetary benefits.

SecurityAuditReviewInput.description: At least one nonempty valid status or review_status is required. A nonempty status takes precedence over review_status; a nonempty note takes precedence over review_note. Notes are truncated to1000runes. Body limit8192bytes; unknown properties are ignored.

gatewayApiKey.description: Gateway API key (sk-…). Read-only audit access; never a session or admin credential.

oidcAccessToken.description: OIDC opaque access token issued by /api/oidc/token
